title: 96Sr + 120Sn experimental gamma-yield validation target
citation: E. Clement et al., Low-energy Coulomb excitation of 96,98Sr beams, Phys. Rev. C 94, 054326 (2016)
particle_detector: annular DSSSD, nominal laboratory 20 to 55 degrees
observation_model: Gaussian peak-intensity estimates with the reported errors; not asserted to be raw Poisson event counts

particle_response_and_bin_mapping.model_support: CM-bin intersection with projectile/recoil event union and an optional energy threshold
still_required: experiment-specific particle identification and trigger selection
treatment of events with both particles detected

note: No detector efficiencies, unreported covariances or missing physical corrections are fabricated. This file is a validation target, not a ready-to-fit example.
